Name: Haran, Son of Ephah
Summary: Son of Caleb's concubine Ephah and father of Gazez.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:46: Son of Caleb's concubine Ephah and father of Gazez.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Haran stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
